# Hampshire Headspace

> Private counselling practice in Eastleigh, Hampshire, run by Ruth Fleming, a BACP-registered humanistic counsellor. Individual counselling for adults aged 16 and over, in person and online. The first 50-minute session is free.

## About

- Counsellor: Ruth Fleming, BACP registered member (418989), fully insured, enhanced DBS, regular clinical supervision.
- Location: Cranberry Wellbeing Centre, 67 Leigh Road, Eastleigh, Hampshire, SO50 9DF (opposite The Point). Free parking.
- Areas served: Eastleigh, Chandler's Ford, Southampton, Hedge End, Romsey, Winchester, and online across the UK.
- Approach: humanistic counselling grounded in connection, compassion and care.

## Fees

- Initial online session: free (50 minutes, to meet and discuss your needs).
- In person, Eastleigh: £55 per 50-minute session.
- Online: £40 per 50-minute session.
